integrity: Proof includes explicit positive-denominator polynomial identity and a complete exact-integer coefficient certificate; standard-library verification recreates all coefficients and checks eight exact-rational independent formula comparisons.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to four positive coupon probabilities and the second collector; does not establish radial monotonicity, higher siblings or arbitrary N. The critical 955-term coefficient certificate is finite and exact. Historical priority remains subject to broader literature review; independent validation not performed.
title: Four-type stochastic domination for the sibling coupon collector
